objective: Determine whether the proven prefill-order branch first appears in the normalized rows entering out_proj or in the request-local projected rows leaving out_proj.

treatment.scope: Observation only inside the existing R106 projection custom op.
treatment.trace: For every pure-prefill invocation, hash exact per-request normalized input rows and request-local projected output rows, recording layer, TP rank, invocation, and live request boundaries.

decision.normalized_digest_partitions_by_order: The remaining branch is at or before RMSNormGated output; compare R97/R99 norm arithmetic per request without changing out_proj.
decision.normalized_same_projected_differs: The request-local FP8 out_proj remains nondeterministic; trace its quantized input and kernel selection before changing arithmetic.
decision.neither_partitions: Extend the trace to the residual/add boundary after out_proj and do not infer a repair from token outputs alone.

resource_boundary: Use 12 GiB container RAM and 16 GiB RAM-plus-swap; no reboot or GPU reset.
reporting_boundary: Observation-only diagnostic. No public throughput, README headline, website, or LocalMaxxing update.
